1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an MTP affixed to an external surface or embedded within a wall of the test tube.

2. (Original) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath and oriented for reading downwards through the bottom of the test tube.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube configured for long-term sample storage at cryogenic temperatures.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in a plastic material selected from polypropylene or acetal polymer, and wherein the plastic material is capable of withstanding temperatures of -20°C or lower.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

13. (Currently Amended) A system for storing samples comprising: the assembly of claim 1; a rack configured to hold a plurality of biorepository test tubes; an automated robot adapted to move the racks or biorepository test tubes; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample from the racks or biorepository test tubes, wherein the system enables automated tracking and retrieval of samples using the embedded MTP.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13, wherein the racks and test tubes are maintained and handled at a temperature of -20°C or less during storage and sample retrieval operations.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: heating an MTP to above the melting point of a plastic material; and melting a portion of the plastic material with the heated MTP to embed the MTP within the plastic.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing a test tube assembly with an embedded MTP; positioning the test tube assembly in a reader device; and reading the MTP through the plastic material in which it is embedded.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein the vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less during the reading operation.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in a plastic material selected from polypropylene or acetal polymer, and wherein the plastic material is capable of withstanding temperatures of -20°C or lower.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.
